data.comment:
# Comfy 1 image input Split Stack - Qwen Multiangle + Wan 2.2

Upload 1 input image and generate 5 alternate angles to be used as start frames with Wan2.2. Each video is stacked horizontally in a final 9x16 video. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/template_rob_split_stack_qwen_multi_wan22.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
